themes.label: Equitable investment to share AI benefits
themes.definition: Calls for equitable investment in emerging technologies like AI so benefits are equally shared between high- and low-income countries.
themes.inclusion: Passages urging equitable investment or sharing of AI benefits across income levels.
themes.exclusion: General digital jobs statements without AI (generic digitalization).
themes.boundary_cases: Investment calls with concrete programmes may also take AI_CAPACITY_BUILDING.

examples.quote: To ensure that the benefits are equally shared, we must continue to invest equitably in emerging technologies, such as artificial intelligence.

themes.label: Digital jobs addressing migration drivers
themes.definition: Digital transformation and high-quality digital jobs framed as a practical response to drivers of irregular migration by closing human-capital gaps.
themes.inclusion: Passages linking digital/AI jobs to economic opportunity and migration.
themes.exclusion: Job displacement concerns (still this code but note framing).
themes.boundary_cases: This is mostly generic digitalization; code only when AI is present in the same passage.

examples.quote: Highquality digital jobs are a practical response to the underlying drivers of irregular migration

value.rationale: The Rwandan passage is mainly about digital transformation and jobs, with AI appearing as an example of emerging technologies requiring equitable investment so benefits are shared.
